ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, flat broad leaves with visible stems and a glossy, slightly wet sheen, loosely piled in a mound on the left half of a white square plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate surface, about 2-3 cm deep at the center | 85
ITEM 2 | Small round golden-orange granules or seeds, roughly 3-5 mm each, scattered in a cluster on top of the greens near the center, matte with slight translucence | 12
ITEM 3 | Sliced pale tan-to-golden chicken-like pieces with browned, slightly crisp edges and light crust, cut into strips about 6-8 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, arranged in an irregular pile along the right side of the plate, covering roughly 30% of the plate | 140
ITEM 4 | Shredded light brown pieces with darker browned edges and fibrous, pulled texture, some with crisp golden surface, mixed among the strips on the lower right of the plate, about 8 cm across and 1 cm high | 55
ITEM 5 | Small pieces of fresh dark green leaves tucked between the meat pieces on the right side, flat and glossy, about 2-4 cm each, sparse | 8
